Name: Fippsie's Animated Trees
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]
Do you wish the world of Stardew Valley felt more alive? 
This mod makes all trees, or only trees of your choice animated. :) 

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
3. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations﻿[/url]﻿.
4. Download and unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
5. Run the game using SMAPI.

To uninstall, just delete it from the mods folder.

[color=#6aa84f][b][size=5]PLEASE READ THE README.TXT TO HELP YOU SET UP THE CONFIG.JSON![/size][/b][/color]

If you want to change the speed at which the trees are moving:
1. Go to \Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP-A] Fippsie's Animated Trees 
2. Open the content.json and find where it says ""AnimationFrameTime": 30".
3. Change the number to 10 or 20 if you want the trees to move faster. Change it to anything higher to make them move slower!

The trees will look special on days that have a festival happening!
